text_block_list.text:
With her race coming up, messages of support
keep pouring into Kitasan Black's phone.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"Next is—ah, it's a classmate!
'Today is my revenge, Kita-chan!'
...they say♪"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"Before that, the lady from the shopping district, and my little brother too—
Everyone's cheers are giving me so much strength!"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"I'll definitely show you I can win!
Just leave it all to me and sit back comfortably!"
